lines.text: Fernandez, wide to Tagliafico.
Fernandez.
Tagliafico.
Di María, wide on the left.
Di María, back to Fernandez.
Argentina are dominating possession. France have to stay patient.
Martínez.
Molina.
Molina scored in the quarter-final against the Netherlands, from a Messi pass.
France keep pushing attacks down the left side; that's where it's paying off for them.
Argentina break! Álvarez leads it.
Di María free on the far side!
GOAL! Ángel Di María scores for Argentina, set up by Alexis MacAllister! Argentina 2-0 France.
Di María with a clinical finish. And what a precise ball from MacAllister.
MacAllister started it, then Messi and Álvarez carried it on.
Wow, huge space for Di María out wide. No one marked him at all.
Di María missed the 2014 final through injury.
Argentina really have this final under control now.
35 minutes played, Argentina 2-0 France.
Deschamps has a big half-time talk to give.
Argentina can't afford to switch off; that one goal changes everything in a final.
Most of the shots are from inside the box—these are real chances being created.
